Job Description : 
 Full Stack Java & Angular Developer
 Strong hands-on experience in Java 17/21 and Spring Boot development.

 Strong understanding of secure coding practices and dependency/framework vulnerability upgrades.
 Excellent communication, analytical, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.
 Candidate should be proactive, quality-focused, and capable of working independently on complex technical issues. 
 We are looking for a highly skilled Full Stack Java & Angular Developer with strong experience in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, SQL, REST APIs, automated testing, and application security .
The candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining enterprise applications, troubleshooting production and development issues, implementing enhancements, and ensuring high-quality, secure, and maintainable code. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills are essential for this role.

Analyze, troubleshoot, and debug application issues across backend, frontend, and database layers.
Develop clean, maintainable, scalable, and high-quality code following established coding standards.

Develop and maintain RESTful APIs following industry best practices, including appropriate HTTP methods, status codes, exception handling, validation, security, and API design principles.
Develop and maintain responsive web applications using Angular .
Perform Angular version upgrades/migrations when required, particularly to address security vulnerabilities, framework updates, and technical dependencies .
Write comprehensive unit tests and maintain the required minimum 90% code coverage .
Troubleshoot and maintain automated tests using JUnit for Java applications and Jest for Angular applications.
Develop, debug, and optimize SQL queries, functions, stored procedures, and database-related code .
Investigate and resolve complex issues by identifying root causes rather than implementing temporary fixes.
Follow secure coding practices and application security standards.
Work with Spring Security and Apigee JWT/token-based authentication .
Collaborate effectively with development, QA, DevOps, and other stakeholders.
Clearly communicate technical issues, root causes, solutions, and implementation approaches to relevant stakeholders.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of development practices.
 Required Technical Skills 
 Backend Java & Spring Boot 
Strong hands-on experience with Java .
Strong understanding of Java 17 and Java 21 .
Ability to work with current Java versions and adapt to future Java version upgrades.
Strong hands-on experience with Spring Boot .
Good understanding of Spring Framework concepts and application development.
Strong knowledge of REST API development and best practices .
Experience with exception handling, validation, logging, API versioning, and error handling.
Strong debugging and troubleshooting capabilities.
 Frontend – Angular 
Strong hands-on experience with Angular , including modern Angular versions.
Experience with Angular 22 or equivalent recent Angular versions.
Strong understanding of Angular architecture, components, services, routing, forms, and dependency injection.
Ability to perform Angular version upgrades/migrations .
Ability to assess and implement framework/dependency upgrades required due to security vulnerabilities and technology updates .
Strong experience with Jest for Angular unit testing.
 Testing & Code Quality 
Strong experience with JUnit and Java unit testing.
Experience maintaining 90% or higher code coverage .
Strong understanding of unit testing best practices, mocking, test isolation, and maintainable test cases.
Hands-on experience with Jest for frontend testing.
Strong understanding of SonarQube/code quality standards .
Ability to write clean code that minimizes Sonar issues, code smells, vulnerabilities, and maintainability problems.
Good understanding of code review and quality assurance practices.
 Database – SQL 
Strong hands-on experience with SQL .
 SQL functions and stored procedures are mandatory. 
Ability to write, optimize, troubleshoot, and debug SQL queries, functions, and stored procedures.
Strong debugging skills for identifying issues across application and database layers.
 Security 
Good understanding of Spring Security .
Experience with JWT-based authentication and authorization .
Hands-on understanding of Apigee JWT/token-based security .
Understanding of secure REST API implementation and authentication best practices.
Awareness of security vulnerabilities and the importance of keeping application frameworks and dependencies up to date.
 Core Competencies 
 Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills .
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Strong attention to code quality and development standards.
Ability to identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
Ability to work independently on complex technical issues.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to clearly explain technical problems and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong ownership and accountability for assigned work.
Good collaboration skills and ability to work effectively within a development team.
 Mandatory Skills 
 Java 17/21 | Spring Boot | Angular | Angular 22 | REST APIs | JUnit | Jest | SQL | SQL Functions | Stored Procedures | SonarQube | Spring Security | JWT | Apigee | Debugging & Troubleshooting 
 Preferred Experience 
Experience working on enterprise-scale applications.
Experience handling application/framework upgrades driven by security vulnerabilities.
Experience working with CI/CD and automated quality gates.
Experience in production issue analysis and root-cause investigation.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.

title: Sr ETRM Developer
description:
Job Summary 
 This role will be based in Cyber Hub Gurugram. We are looking for an experienced senior ETRM/full-stack developer with strong hands-on experience in commodity trading systems, enterprise application development, and oil and power markets. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 7+ years of relevant professional experience, including at least 3+ years of hands-on experience in power markets. Experience working with an ETRM/CTRM application vendor or within a commodity trading organization is highly desirable. The role will be part of the Trading Systems Specialist team, supporting the growth of our commercial energy trading business across Europe and North America. The successful candidate will work closely with Trading, Middle Office, Trade Management, and Supply and Logistics teams, as well as IT and external application vendors. A key responsibility will be to independently contribute to the design, architecture and development of our in-house power trading systems, taking ownership from business requirements and solution design through development, testing, deployment and ongoing support. 

 Roles Responsibilities 

 ETRM Development and Application Management 
 Drive the design, development and delivery of C/ETRM enhancements. Analyze business requirements, propose technical solutions and independently deliver application developments. Develop, maintain, debug and optimize application code, database components and supporting services. Automate application processes, operational tasks and business controls. Provide technical support to business users and troubleshoot application issues. Maintain technical documentation and work with vendors to resolve defects and improve system functionality. 

 In-House Power Trading Systems Development 
 Contribute to the architecture, design and development of in-house power trading systems. Translate trading requirements into scalable technical solutions covering trade capture, position management, scheduling, nominations, settlement and reporting. Work closely with power trading stakeholders to understand market requirements and operational workflows. Independently drive technical initiatives from requirements gathering through design, development, testing and implementation. Develop integrations with power market platforms, exchanges, scheduling systems and external data providers. 

 Full-Stack Application Development 
 Develop enterprise backend applications and services using Java and Spring Boot. Design, develop and maintain REST APIs and microservices. Develop modern frontend applications using React, Angular or equivalent frameworks. Integrate frontend applications with backend services and relational databases. Apply software engineering best practices covering application architecture, performance, security and maintainability. 

 System Integration, Cloud and Automation 
 Develop and maintain integrations between ETRM and enterprise applications, including ERP, planning and scheduling systems. Design and support APIs, data pipelines and automated workflows. Work with relational databases, SQL, data modelling and Python scripting. Develop and support application and data workloads on AWS and/or Azure. Support workflow orchestration using tools such as AWS MWAA (Apache Airflow). Use API testing and documentation tools such as Postman and Swagger. Support system monitoring, performance optimization and operational reliability. 

 Business Support and Project Delivery 
 Support daily trading, middle-office and operational reporting requirements. Work closely with business stakeholders and IT teams to resolve technical and operational challenges. Manage application enhancements, releases and vendor upgrades. Support technical testing, UAT and production deployments. Manage technical issues and vendor escalations. Follow established change management, release management and incident management processes. 

 Job Requirements 

 Education 
 Degree in computer science, software engineering or a related technical discipline. 

 Experience 
 Minimum 7+ years of relevant professional experience in software development, ETRM/CTRM systems or enterprise application development. Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience in power markets - essential. Experience working with an ETRM/CTRM vendor or commodity trading organization is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience independently delivering application development and integration projects. 

 Behavioral Skills 
 Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical deliverables end-to-end. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and deliver sustainable solutions. Ability to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technical solutions. Demonstrated capability to design and build solutions rather than relying solely on vendor support. Strong communication, stakeholder management and collaboration skills. High attention to detail, proactive approach and strong delivery focus. 

 Technical Skills 
 Experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms. Familiarity with AWS MWAA / Apache Airflow. Experience with Docker, containerization and automated deployments. Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Grafana, Kibana or Zabbix. Experience with ServiceNow, JIRA and Change Management processes. Strong understanding of ETRM/CTRM applications and end-to-end commodity trading processes. Minimum 3+ years of power market experience. Understanding power trading workflows, including trade capture, position management, scheduling, nominations, settlement, pricing and risk management. Knowledge of physical commodity trading, freight, logistics and supply operations. Experience with ETRM platforms such as Amphora Symphony, Endur, RightAngle or equivalent is desirable. 

 Knowledge 
 Experience using AI-powered development tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or GitHub Copilot. Experience designing or implementing in-house ETRM/CTRM or power trading solutions. Exposure to power exchanges, market operators, balancing mechanisms and market data providers. Experience with Power BI or other business intelligence tools.

Planning and Design - Works with the product team and stakeholders to refine and document requirements. - Estimates effort for planning purposes. - Designs and documents scalable frontend architecture: component structure, state management, caching and module boundaries. - Contributes to a shared design system and reusable UI component library. - Applies user experience (UX) principles and techniques to create simple, intuitive, accessible and consistent software.

Comfortable working independently in ambiguous environments with minimal oversight.

description:
Senior UI/UX Designer Motion & Interaction Company: EduBridge Learning Pvt. Ltd.
 Department: Product & Learning Solutions
 Location: Mumbai (Work from Office)
 Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
 Experience: 46 Years
 Reporting To: President Product & Learning Solutions
 Industry: EdTech / E-Learning 
 About EduBridge EduBridge Learning is one of India's leading workforce skilling companies, focused on empowering young people through education, skill development and career opportunities. Our Product & Learning Solutions team develops technology-driven products that support learning and career progression, including AI-powered language learning applications, job readiness assessment platforms, international career platforms and career services tools. 
 Role Overview 
 We are looking for an experienced Senior UI/UX Designer – Motion & Interaction to lead the end-to-end design experience across our web and mobile products. The role will be responsible for creating intuitive user experiences, developing a unified design system, and bringing product interactions to life through motion design and animations. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in UI/UX, product design, Figma and motion tools, along with the ability to collaborate closely with product and engineering teams. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Product & UI/UX Design Own end-to-end UI/UX design across web and mobile applications. Create user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes. Translate product requirements into intuitive and user-friendly experiences. Improve existing interfaces and design new product features. Ensure consistency across different user journeys and platforms. 2. Design System Development Build and maintain a unified design system across all products. Develop reusable components, typography, colour palettes, spacing, icons and design guidelines. Maintain design documentation and ensure consistency in implementation. Collaborate with developers to ensure design accuracy. 3. Motion & Interaction Design Create animations, transitions, micro-interactions and interactive elements. Design engaging motion experiences for AI-powered learning products. Develop animated characters and interactions for AI learning companions. Optimise animations for low-end Android devices and limited network connectivity. Prepare animation assets using Rive, Lottie or other relevant tools. 4. User Research & Usability Conduct user research and usability testing. Understand user behaviour and identify areas of improvement. Design accessible and responsive interfaces. Simplify experiences for first-time smartphone users. 5. Cross-functional Collaboration Work closely with product managers, developers and leadership teams. Provide detailed design specifications and asset handovers. Review product implementation and ensure alignment with approved designs. Participate in product reviews and sprint planning. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 4–6 years of experience in UI/UX Design, Product Design or Interaction Design. Strong portfolio demonstrating shipped web and mobile products. Demonstrated experience in motion design and interactive animations. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, auto layout and prototyping. Hands-on experience with at least one of the following: Rive, Lottie, Adobe After Effects or Framer Motion. Strong understanding of typography, colour theory, visual hierarchy and responsive design. Knowledge of accessibility and usability principles. Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Ability to independently own design projects from concept to implementation. 
 Preferred Skills Experience working with EdTech, SaaS or AI-based products. Experience designing chat-based or voice-based user experiences. Knowledge of Rive state machines and animated characters. Experience designing applications for low-bandwidth environments and budget Android devices. Familiarity with React, React Native or Flutter. Experience with Linear, Jira or similar project management tools. 
 Education B.Des, M.Des or a degree in Design, HCI, Fine Arts, Multimedia or a related discipline. Candidates with strong relevant portfolios and practical experience will be preferred. 
 First 90-Day Deliverables First 30 Days: Audit existing products, identify design inconsistencies and define improvement priorities. First 60 Days: Develop and implement the initial version of the unified design system in Figma. First 90 Days: Redesign and ship one complete learner journey with motion interactions and document motion design guidelines. 
 Application Process Interested candidates can share their updated resume, portfolio link and motion design reel at: Email: ranjeet@edubridgeindia.in
 Subject Line: Senior UI/UX Designer Note: Applications without a portfolio link and motion design work will not be considered.

description:
Job Summary 
 Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions. We are looking for Senior Software Architect to work with 25+ strong product development organization in Pune. Cloud Architect will design, develop and guide overall cloud architecture of Cloud SaaS product and its interconnections to other Varian and Siemens products. In addition, the role will have a product focus to dive deep into the software architecture on selected features. You will have an opportunity to work with a talented engineering team on a cloud native SaaS application. As we are in regulated medical domain, information security is an important design consideration in everything we do. The product is Siemens Healthineers' cloud-based software solution for patient relationships and care navigation management. It's designed to connect cancer patients with their clinics online throughout the entire cancer journey. The product used by 35,000+ active cancer patients and healthcare professionals from leading oncology centers in North America and Europe. The candidate in this role will provide strong product development leadership to a team of software engineers and test engineers, working in an agile/scrum environment. 

 Job Description 

 Position Duties: 
 Responsible for contributing/driving technical architecture Engineering group in Pune. This includes all aspects of design and architecture - performance, scalability, reusability, testability, and simplicity. Work collaboratively with product management to understand business requirements and convert them into technical architecture. Hands on elaborate develop proof of concept for next generation technology solutions. Integrate Generative AI capabilities into the design and development lifecycle. Work in tandem with other Architects within Varian/Siemens groups and influence them on technology and solutions of Noona product. Effectively drive technical architecture and design reviews and influence global stakeholders in global forum and obtain agreement with the stakeholders. Effectively communication the architectural concepts to the development scrum teams and guide/support them to implement/adopt new architecture, design, framework, or tools in respective projects. Demonstrate leadership, technically mentor engineering leads and scrum team members to drive towards continuously improving their effectiveness. 

 Qualifications

 8-12 years of experience in software application development with 4 years of working experience in senior technical role. Strong object-oriented programming skills in Java and Kotlin with Spring. Experience using AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude, or similar tools. Strong frontend programming skills in TypeScript and Angular. Mobile app development experience with open-source UI toolkit (React Native, Flutter etc.). Experience working with source control and configuration management tools like GitLab. Experience in SQL database technologies (PostgreSQL and Snowflake technologies are a plus). Experience with working in Cloud native SaaS environment such as AWS or Azure. Working knowledge of Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) and Microservice Architecture. Experience in security implementations/best practices in cloud environment. Hands on experience in software development using agile/scrum framework. Proficient in oral and written communication in English (no Finnish required). 

 Nice to have 
 Experience developing healthcare products conforming quality system regulations. Experience in healthcare domain and medical interoperability standards such as FHIR, HL7. Certifications from AWS or Azure.
